verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say structured output lets an agent return an object matching a schema-defined shape instead of text, which covers the core of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic retries when validation fails, and the structured-output support rests on a single thin mention. missing for 10: automatic retry on schema-validation failure, detailed structured-output docs (validation behavior, streaming of structured objects), independent or hands-on corroboration
